verdict.rationale: SendGrid publishes a structured v3 API reference with per-endpoint pages such as POST /v3/mail/send. It also provides copy-and-run sample code in multiple languages and cURL, so runnable examples are documented. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive, for example an in-browser 'try it' console that executes calls, so only part of the story is supported. Missing for 10: an interactive in-browser API explorer, evidence that examples run directly from the reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
